name: Academic Classical Oil
description: A calm, still scene look with academic oil-painting brushwork, smooth blended transitions, warm low-angle light, and a deliberately incident-free composition.
style_bible: Academic and classical oil-painting technique, painted for stillness. Medium and surface: smooth blended brushwork with the strokes largely worked out of the surface, glazed and slowly built, a soft even sheen across the whole canvas, impasto reserved for a highlight on wet marble, a metal rim, or a petal edge; fine craquelure and a warm varnish tone over everything. Edges and shapes: firm and carefully drawn where the light falls on a solid surface, softening in the shadows, with reflected light carried up into every shadow so that nothing goes truly black; distance rendered by warm aerial haze rather than by loss of drawing. Palette: warm ivory, bleached marble white, honey, amber, old gold and sun-warmed rose, set against restrained sea-blue, olive, and dusty terracotta accents; low saturation, high key, and no colour permitted to shout. Lighting: broad warm directional light entering from one side at a low angle, laying long soft-edged bars of light across the surfaces; no hard-edged theatrical spotlight, no cold light. Texture: the materials the scene gives, described by their own weight and sheen rather than by ornament, and the fine grain of dust only where a shaft of light falls. Subject grammar: one clear focal subject at rest and a deliberate absence of incident. Where the scene includes figures, they are painted with the same academic handling as everything else and never given an invented likeness, and are shown at middle distance or further where the scene allows so that no face carries the frame. Framing: eye level or slightly raised, horizontals kept level and calm, generous open negative space, the subject placed off-centre and small, and the composition resolved rather than dynamic. Low stimulation is the contract: nothing is beginning or ending, no incident, no motion, no confrontation, no crowd pressing forward, no face close to camera, and no strong tonal contrast anywhere. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed place, monument, event, or copied composition.
negative_prompt: action, movement, running, fighting, combat action, tissue or wound texture, screaming faces, close-up faces, head-and-shoulders crop, crowds pressing forward, riot, mob, panic, dramatic chiaroscuro, hard black shadows, printed signage, saturated neon, acid colour, high contrast, HDR look, heavy vignette, photograph, photorealistic camera render, 3D render, CGI, flat vector, cel shading, anime, cartoon, comic ink, readable lettering, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, borders, UI elements, copied reference composition
